question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.**

Raman had always been attracted to __the scientific study of sound__ and decided to take up a course in sound engineering to pursue his dream career.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 1 i.e. Acoustics.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Acoustics** is a term referring to the science concerned with the production, control, transmission, reception, and effects of sound. (ध्वनिशास्त्र)
 
• From the above sentence, it is clear that **Acoustics **is the correct substitution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Agronomy **is the science and technology of producing and using plants by agriculture for food, fuel, fiber, chemicals, recreation, or land conservation. (कृषि विज्ञान; कृषिशास्त्र; सस्यविज्ञान)
 
• **Alchemy **means a form of chemistry in the Middle Ages which involved trying to discover how to change ordinary metals into gold. (कीमिया रसायन विद्या से सम्बंधित)
 
• **Aesthetics **means the study of beauty, especially in art.(सौन्दर्य बोध; सौंदर्यशास्त्र)

36:T5bf,

The correct answer is **option 1 i.e. To remain valid.**
